summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-5C41, a commercial mortgage pass-through certificate issuing entity, filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a pooling and servicing agreement on May 21, 2026. The agreement governs the issuance of certificates representing beneficial ownership in the trust, whose assets consist of 33 commercial, multifamily, and manufactured housing community mortgage loans. The filing also notes that a specific whole loan asset, The Towers at Cupertino City Center Whole Loan, was previously serviced under the same agreement but as of June 11, 2026, is now serviced under a separate pooling and servicing agreement. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present; this is a routine securitization disclosure under Item 1.01.
